input.SPEC:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Lumen API
  version: '1.0'
paths:
  /v1/events:
    post:
      summary: Send an event
      operationId: sendEvent
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [type, payload]
              properties:
                type:
                  type: string
                  description: The event type, e.g. order.created
                payload:
                  type: object
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Event accepted for delivery
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  event_id:
                    type: string
                  status:
                    type: string
  /v1/subscriptions/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getSubscription
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Subscription found
        '404':
          description: No subscription exists with the given id
